notes.title: HSH2 PART2 IS NOW AVAILABLE !
notes.notes:
We want to sincerely apologize to everyone as HSH2 Part 2 has been delayed. Now, HSH2 Part 2 is available as a free update on Steam for those who had already purchased HSH2.

For those who haven't tried HSH yet, be sure to grab one cause HSH2 is currently 20% off on Steam. 

Patch Updates 1.1.0 (This patch will take roughly 3.6 GB)

1. Add more contents
2. Add new mode 'Chapter Select'
3. Add Simplified Chinese language
4. Fix minor bugs

Remark : For those who had already played the first part, you can continue playing from the previous saves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35502893/f78f8fb82743df457078fe8dab2225b0a15caf15.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Postponing HSH2 Part 2
notes.notes:
Important Annoucement :

According to our previous annoucement regarding HSH2 Part 2 which is going to be updated in this Halloween day. We want to sincerely apologize to everyone that we have to
postpone the date. We promise to update part 2 as soon as possible, please rest assured that the date will not go beyond this year.

To deliver the best gaming experience is our motto.
We, Ningbo Inception and Ygggame team, put a lot of efforts in the production process. However, in order to deliver the best horror experience, we need a little bit of time to polish the game to perfection.

Even though part 2 isn't going to be updated in this 31st October, we will have a new mode where players can select the game difficulty. Also, the game balance will be adjusted.
All of these are going to be updated on this 31st October.

Thank you for always supporting us.

Ygggame Team
